event-camera.title: Event Cameras
event-camera.page_intro: Event cameras are the most widespread type of neuromorphic vision sensor. Their pixels contain dedicated circuits to detect sudden changes in illuminance. Event cameras report these changes asynchronously as a stream of events containing timestamps, pixel coordinates, and brightness polarity.
event-camera.meta_description: Explore event-based neuromorphic vision sensors, temporal contrast sensors, and dynamic vision sensors.
